slots.sentence: Hundreds of people attended the moments of silence at their height, while now there are only 30 to 40 people coming on a weekly basis, he said.

slots.name: employment status
slots.sentence: A senior UN agency director has said that he lost his job because he criticised Israeli policies in Gaza.

slots.name: termination date
slots.sentence: Ben Davis, who had been Director of Rural Transformation and Gender Equality at the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), told AFP news agency on Wednesday that he was informed in July that his contract would not be renewed because he had allegedly breached impartiality rules.
